name: Marty Neilson

summary.text: Marty Neilson is a retired chief financial officer who worked for several companies in Colorado and Texas and holds a master's degree in business management.

experience.text: Chief financial officer for several companies in Colorado and Texas.
District-level delegate to the 2016 Republican National Convention from Colorado, one of seven unpledged Colorado delegates.

education_focus.text: Neilson says CU should look at the total cost of attendance, control costs, improve graduation rates, and target financial aid effectively to address affordability.
On artificial intelligence, she says it 'should add to education not replace the educational process,' pointing to CU's existing rule that students complete AI training before using it in coursework.
On federal oversight, she says she would commit CU 'to the law, to academic excellence, to responsible stewardship of public resources' and supports 'equal treatment and transparency' in admissions.
